integrity: The proof reconstructs the published tight right-hand side, derives the exact slack identity, normalizes subset normals intrinsically in the affine hyperplane, and obtains a matching universal upper bound and uniqueness from the singleton supporting inequalities. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard Pilaud--Poliakova realization with at least two light labels and at least one shade label. It gives tight-subset shell distances and the unique Euclidean inball, but not circumradii, John ellipsoids, or affine-invariant data. Redundant tight inequalities are not asserted to be facets.
title: Higher Hochschild polytopes have an exact permutahedral facet-shell law
